metadata.title: जंगल से सूअर कांदा कैसे हासिल किया जाता है | Lajawab Suran from Jungle of Bastar
metadata.description: The Kangan valley reserve forest has huge number of wild boars. These wild boars feast on the Jimikand (wild yam) in the forest. The Jimikand is also favourite food of tribals of Bastar. In this episode of tribal kitchen we will show how to get this Jimikand or Suran from the Jungle and cook.
